basic_details.job_title: IISER Kolkata Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: IISER Kolkata will hold a walk-in interview on 18 November 2026, with reporting at 9:30 AM, in Lab M254, Second Floor, Research Complex, IISER Kolkata. The interview is for one temporary Project Associate-I post in the Centre for Climate and Environmental Studies, on a DST-funded project. The pay is Rs 31000 + HRA per month (as per rule).

The notice also says relaxation in age, educational qualifications or experience may be considered in case of exceptionally meritorious candidates.

content_sections.heading: About IISER Kolkata
content_sections.text: IISER Kolkata is the institute inviting candidates for this post. The post is in the Centre for Climate and Environmental Studies, under the project "Establishment of Nodal Center for Key Starting materials and intermediates under Therapeutic Chemicals Program", funded by DST, Government of India. The project intends to harness the potential of marine metabolites for potential therapeutics. It also intends to undertake targeted biodiscovery of marine microbes, focusing on actinomycetes and cyanobacteria, from biotopes representing the coastal ocean of India.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice invites applicants for one post, Project Associate-I. The qualification is a Master's degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences/MVSc, or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine, from a recognized University or equivalent. Experience with conducting field sampling activities in coastal ocean biotopes, or biodiscovery of microbes such as from the mangroves, would be welcome. The notice describes this experience as welcome, not as a requirement. Candidates must not be over 35 years as on 18 November 2026. This can be relaxed for certain reserved categories as per rules of Government of India. The notice also says relaxation in age, educational qualifications or experience may be considered in case of exceptionally meritorious candidates. The pay is Rs 31000 + HRA per month (as per rule). The position is temporary and will initially be for a period of one year. It will be extended for one more year based on satisfactory performance of the candidate. Candidates should check the official notification for any further details on each point.

faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 18 November 2026. Reporting time is 9:30 AM.
